미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건
일간 메모리 현물가격
[미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건/김제호]
기준: 2025.4.16(수)
◆ DRAM: 제품 평균 +0.1%(6개 상승)
*DDR5 Premium vs. DDR4: +57.6%
→ 양측 제품 견적 문의 및 제시 활동 둔화. 제품 전반 소폭 가격 변동폭 지속, 거래활동 제한적
Market activity remained weak, with limited visibility of orders. Both buyers and sellers showed a lack of enthusiasm in quoting and inquiring. Overall, chip prices continued to fluctuate, and transaction activity was sluggish.
◆ NAND: *금일 현물가 미제공
→ 공급업체 TP 인하 불구 공장 관망세 지속, 웨이퍼 수요 약세. 제품 전반 가격 약세, 거래활동 제한적
Buying momentum was quiet. Suppliers continued to adjust their quotations, but demand for wafers was also weak. Factories maintained a cautious wait-and-see approach due to future uncertainties, with no significant inquiries observed. The market trended downward slowly.
(Source: DRAMeXchange)

미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건
일간 메모리 현물가격
[미래에셋증권 반도체 김영건/김제호]
기준: 2025.4.17(목)
◆ DRAM: 제품 평균 +0.4%(12개 상승)
*DDR5 Premium vs. DDR4: +57.1%
→ DDR4 1Gx8-3200 브랜드 칩 위주 견적 문의 발생, 저가 구간 거래 발생. 제품 전반 가격 소폭 상승, 거래량 제한적
Momentum was moderate, with inquiries mainly focused on DDR4 1Gx8-3200 branded chips. There was clear buying activity at lower price points, which slightly drove spot prices upward. However, buyers remained cautious, and actual transaction volumes were limited.
◆ NAND: *금일 현물가 미제공
→ 양측 관망세 유지, 일부 품목 외 제품 전반 수요 약세. eMMC 가격 변동폭 제한적, 거래활동 제한적
eMMC prices remained stable, and overall buying momentum was quiet. Both supply and demand sides maintained a conservative, wait-and-see approach. Only occasional inquiries were made for specific part numbers, while demand for other chips remained weak.
(Source: DRAMeXchange)
